style: Flat cel-shaded neon anime, thick black ink lines, hard-edged shadows, every person and crowd drawn in the same crisp style.
sky: Blue-black night sky, magenta and cyan neon, steady light.

roof_run.description: a wide flat rain-slick rooftop at night, a round water tank on the right, a gap and a taller rooftop in the far background, the neon city beyond.

roof_edge.description: a rooftop edge at night: on the left a billboard with a wordless glowing cyan can ad and a fixed yellow steel ladder down its side; on the right an open square metal vent; the neon city below.

alley.description: a narrow back alley at night behind the market: brick walls, a fire escape on the right wall, a square vent grate low on the left wall, puddles reflecting neon.

market.description: a night market street that forks: a dense crowd under glowing umbrellas on the left, the dark mouth of an alley on the right, red lanterns overhead.

platform.description: an elevated train platform at night: a graffiti-covered train on the left with one open door lit red inside, a fixed yellow steel ladder up the side of the car on the right, a yellow edge line on the wet platform.

carriage.description: inside a dark empty subway carriage at night: the aisle runs straight away from the camera, rows of seats on both sides, grab poles, steady red emergency light.

train_roof.description: the top of a speeding elevated train at night seen from behind, a parallel highway on the right, an exit ramp curving up and to the right far ahead, the neon skyline.

cab.description: inside the cab of a yellow van at night, seen from behind the two front seats: the steering wheel in front of the left seat, the windshield and the neon city streaking past ahead.

rin.card: Rin: a chrome robotic left arm on the {left} side of the picture and a brown-skinned right arm on the {right} side; black hair shaved on her left side and a long fringe with acid-yellow tips on her right side; only her left eye glows cyan; black bomber with magenta lining and one big glowing cyan lightning bolt across its back; charcoal cargo pants; plain white chunky sneakers.
rin.locks: Her chrome left arm stays chrome, only her left eye glows, and the bolt on her jacket stays cyan.

hound.card: The Hound: tall and lean, matte black bodysuit, smooth faceless helmet with one thin red visor slit, crimson scarf, a glowing red blade along his right forearm on the {right} side of the picture, a small white hexagon on his left shoulder on the {left} side.
hound.locks: His blade stays on his right forearm and his visor stays one thin red line.

dex.card: Dex: heavyset, bald, gray-streaked beard, orange goggles pushed up on his forehead, chrome jaw, teal bomber with patches.
dex.locks: Dex stays in the driver's seat.
